## 5. BrewTec website
Serves the company homepage with the employee assistant at
`/webhook/brewtec`

The chat inside the page calls workflow 3 at the same address, so it works on localhost and through a Cloudflare tunnel without changes.

**Setup**
No credentials. Click Publish.
Open http://localhost:5678/webhook/brewtec

To change the page, edit the HTML in **Send website**.
